<function name="GetViewOffsetDucked" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns the ducked view offset of the player, which equals the difference between the player's actual position and their view when ducked.

See also <page>Player:GetViewOffset</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Vector">New crouching view offset, must be local vector to player's <page>Entity:GetPos</page></ret>
	</rets>
</function>
